hook_text: Fold a rectangle corner to corner. Do the halves match? Most people say yes.
clip_script: A rectangle does NOT have symmetry along its diagonals. Folding along a diagonal makes the corners miss each other, unless the rectangle is a square. This is the most common error in this topic. A rectangle has two lines of symmetry: one vertical and one horizontal.
visual_style: An A4 sheet folds along its diagonal and the corners stick out awkwardly; then it folds top to bottom and side to side, matching perfectly; a stop sign spins showing eight lines.
pacing: Failed fold, two good folds, octagon bonus.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson to find every line of symmetry and finish a butterfly.
